scope: Isolated Conexiuni replacement authoring only. No pack, KG, ranking, runtime, Intrusul, Perechi, verifier, or session-store file is changed.

constraints_verified: four groups of four and sixteen unique existing nodes
maximum two shared members with every full-pack, tombstoned, or same-batch group
maximum seven shared members with every full-pack or tombstoned board
no mirrors, member leaks, literal surface crossfits, type shortcuts, or vague catch-all predicates

proposal_policy.method: Each selection below was compared with a complete predecessor proposal whose four groups are recorded in the cited manifest. All four selected group predicates differ from that predecessor; no rejected quad was repaired by a one-tile swap.
